question: Does the Nomic Atlas Embedding API still carry a free token grant?
why: older third-party pages cite 1M to 10M free tokens on the Atlas Embedding API; https://docs.nomic.ai/atlas/embeddings-and-retrieval/generate-embeddings and https://www.nomic.ai/pricing (read 2026-11-03) state no free token amount, and the pricing page lists only 'Limited agent requests' on the Free plan. compute/nomic describes the document-parsing product.
